entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Brive-la-Gaillarde - Toulouse railway is a 248-kilometre French railway line that connects the rural areas between Brive-la-Gaillarde and the large southern city of Toulouse via Figeac and Capdenac. The railway was opened in several stages between 1858 and 1864.
